seo.title: Accounting
seo.seo_description: AI reads your documents, prepares the pre-entry and flags discrepancies: your accountant reviews and decides. Bank reconciliation is not delivered today.

blocks.role: Promesse de la solution comptabilité : l'IA prépare, le comptable décide.

translation.headline: A pre-entry ready. The accountant decides.
translation.subheadline: The system reads your documents, prepares the pre-entry (the lines ready to be picked up in the books) and flags discrepancies. Your accountant reviews, corrects and approves: the AI prepares, it does not post.

blocks.role: Problème : exemple construit d'un cabinet comptable en fin de mois.

translation.title: Month-end means data entry.
translation.body:
A small accounting firm receives invoices, expense reports and statements from its clients, in every shape imaginable: photos of receipts, PDFs, forwarded emails. At month-end, the assistant rereads amounts and retypes lines, while the accountant could be advising clients.

This example is constructed to illustrate the principle; it is not a customer's result.

items.title: Checks to repeat.
items.text: The pre-tax amounts, the taxes and the total must agree.

items.title: Advice time lost.
items.text: What the client really pays for is the accountant's judgment.

blocks.role: Ce que fait le système : lecture, contrôles de cohérence, table, relecture.

translation.title: From document to pre-entry.
translation.intro: The accountant defines the fields and the control rules; the system applies them document by document, with WorkStudio's AI document reading.

cards.title: It reads the documents.
cards.text: Invoices, quotes, purchase orders, expense reports: starter templates exist for these four types.

cards.title: It checks.
cards.text: It verifies that pre-tax amounts and taxes add up to the total, to within a few cents, and marks doubtful documents.

cards.title: It prepares.
cards.text: One pre-entry line per document, with the fields agreed with the accountant (category, supplier, project).

cards.title: It waits.
cards.text: The accountant reviews the lines, corrects and approves. Nothing is recorded before that.

blocks.role: Ce que reçoit l'équipe : mosaïque de bénéfices (bento), dont le renvoi vers OPSYS-AI pour la construction (statut pilote).

translation.title: A file reviewed, not retyped.
translation.intro: A table of documents ready to review, with the discrepancies at the top.

cards.title: A pre-entry table.
cards.text: One row per document, with the "to review" flag.

cards.title: The reasons for discrepancies.
cards.text: Missing field, unreadable value, total that does not add up.

cards.title: Time for judgment.
cards.text: The accountant spends time advising rather than retyping.

cards.title: For construction, OPSYS-AI goes further.
cards.text: Its Finance department (M5) aims to prepare invoicing and track job costs. OPSYS-AI is a product in development: a targeted reading of costs is locally qualified, but complete accounting, payroll and connectors are not demonstrated.

blocks.role: Bénéfice attendu, sans chiffre ; lien diagnostic.

translation.title: Time handed back to advice.
translation.body:
The expected benefit: less retyping and errors caught sooner, hence more time for what the client really pays for, their accountant's judgment. No quantified gain is announced; it is measured during a pilot, on your own files.

Book an assessment to define your fields and your control rules.

blocks.role: Ce qui reste sous contrôle, et ce qui n'est pas livré (rapprochement bancaire) ; carte données avec lien Vos données.

translation.title: The accountant has the last word.

cards.title: The accountant keeps the decision.
cards.text: No entry is recorded without their approval.

cards.title: No bank link.
cards.text: Bank reconciliation is not delivered in WorkStudio. It can be studied as custom work, from statements you export, with no connection to your bank.

cards.title: Your software, to be qualified.
cards.text: Writing to your accounting software goes through a connector that is qualified during the assessment, software by software.

cards.title: Your tax rules.
cards.text: The document-reading templates are not yet adapted to Quebec. Quebec taxes, categories and chart of accounts are defined with you and checked on your documents.

cards.title: No accounting advice.
cards.text: The system prepares and checks; it does not advise. The decisions stay with your accountant.

cards.title: Your data stays yours.
cards.text: On your server or with us, in Quebec: never used to train a model, never sold. An external reading service comes in only when you explicitly activate it, in writing.

blocks.role: FAQ propre à la solution comptabilité.

items.question: Does the AI do the accounting?
items.answer: No. It prepares the pre-entry and flags discrepancies. The entries and the decisions stay with your accountant.

items.question: Can bank reconciliation be automated?
items.answer: Not with a product delivered today. A custom study is possible, based on exported statements, with no bank connection.

items.question: Does my accountant have to change tools?
items.answer: No, in principle: the pre-entry is filed in a table, and what follows depends on the software they use, which we qualify with them.

items.question: Do my documents leave my server?
items.answer: Not if the reading is done with a model on your server. An external reading service is possible, only with your written agreement, and it is flagged.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: There is no public price yet for accounting pre-entry. Two things are paid for. Support (assessment, installation, configuration): a written estimate follows the assessment and says what is included and what is not. Use of the platform: in credits, because anything that calls an AI model uses them; a plan gives you credits and storage every month, otherwise you top up. Platform prices will appear on the Pricing page once they are published.

items.question: What uses credits here?
items.answer: Each time the system calls an AI model hosted by Nexora AI to read a document, extract its fields or check a total, it uses credits: one credit equals one Canadian cent of tokens at the model catalogue price. Steps that call no model use none. When none are left, the call is refused with a message pointing to top-ups and plans. The credit platform is not yet open for sale.

translation.title: Let's talk about your month-end.
translation.text: Describe your documents and your software. We will tell you what can be prepared, what can be connected and what stays with your accountant. A partner from here installs, runs and trains with you.
